<observations>
Date: Mar 20, 2026
* 🔴 (07:12) User stated they will enforce strict null checks / TypeScript strict mode in Ledgerly.
* 🔴 (09:40) User stated SOC 2 audit fieldwork starts May 19, 2026.
* 🔴 (10:30) User switched database from SQLite to PostgreSQL for production.
* 🟡 (20:30) User asked for a summary of pending PRs and reviewers.

Date: Mar 23, 2026
* 🔴 (07:05) User announced adoption of semantic commit messages.
* 🟡 (09:20) Agent merged PR #42 (discount code validation) reviewed by @sara; implemented LaunchDarkly feature flag in `src/flags.ts`.
* 🟡 (13:00) User stated public API rate limit is 300 requests per minute *(superseded on Mar 29)*.
* 🟡 (13:45) Agent refactored invoice PDF generation to use `pdf-lib`.

Date: Mar 26, 2026
* 🔴 (16:40) User asked whether recurring invoices could be paused per client; agent added ConfigCat "recurringPause" toggle.
* 🟡 (19:45) Agent scheduled sales team demo for recurring invoices.

Date: Mar 29, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User decided to adopt dark mode UI across the Ledgerly dashboard.
* 🔴 (10:20) User stated public API rate limit raised to 500 requests per minute (replacing 300 r/min limit).
* ✅ (13:30) Agent merged branch `feature/dark-mode` into develop (approved by @sara) and deployed to staging with Percy visual regression tests.
* 🔴 (14:15) User asked if bulk invoice upload could support Excel (`.xlsx`); agent implemented `/api/v1/invoices/bulk-upload` via SheetJS.

Date: Apr 2, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User decided to add recurring invoice templates (`recurring_invoices` table and `/api/v1/invoices/recurring` endpoint).
* 🔴 (11:40) User asked whether PDF invoices could include a company logo watermark; agent integrated `pdfmake`.
* ✅ (13:15) Agent deployed PDF watermark feature to staging.
* 🟡 (15:05) Agent added BullMQ background job to process PDF generation asynchronously to resolve staging CPU spikes.
* ✅ (17:45) Agent merged branch `feature/recurring-invoices` into develop after approval from @kim.

Date: Apr 6, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User decided to integrate Stripe for subscription payments (`stripeService.ts` and webhook `/api/v1/payments/stripe/webhook` covering `charge.succeeded` and `invoice.payment_failed`).
* 🔴 (11:35) User asked whether payment receipt emails could include an invoice QR code; agent integrated `qrcode` library.
* ✅ (13:00) Agent deployed Stripe integration and QR code email feature to development.
* 🟡 (15:40) Agent added nightly cron job to prune orphaned payment records from the database.
* 🟡 (16:30) Agent recommended Redis Streams for background job queue; user agreed.
* 🟡 (16:55) Agent added Snyk security scan to CI pipeline.
* ✅ (18:20) Agent merged branch `feature/stripe-integration` into main after approval from @alex.
</observations>
